name: phd-atlas
description: Securely manage PhD Atlas applications, profiles, deadlines, files, communications, and account-scoped workflows through a Codex Skill and local stdio MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Manage your PhD application workspace securely from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connect one or more PhD Atlas accounts with revocable long-lived authorizations, then use the bundled Skill and local stdio MCP tools within each account's real permissions across applications, profiles, deadlines, files, communications, discovery, and settings.
defaultPrompt: Show my PhD applications and next deadlines.
Update an application after checking its current state.
Review my profile assets and application checklist.
